versions.subject: new rules: Sigma rules based on Elastic rules (#3632)
versions.detection:
selection_1_name:
    - Image|endswith: '\odbcconf.exe'
    - OriginalFilename: 'odbcconf.exe'
selection_1_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-a'
        - '-f'
        - '/a'
        - '/f'
        - 'regsvr'
selection_2:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\odbcconf.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
condition: all of selection_1_* or selection_2
versions.spl: (Image="*\\odbcconf.exe" OR OriginalFilename="odbcconf.exe" CommandLine IN ("*-a*", "*-f*", "*/a*", "*/f*", "*regsvr*")) OR (ParentImage="*\\odbcconf.exe" Image="*\\rundll32.exe")
